description: The HR-78 RTO office is located in Shahabad Markanda within the Kurukshetra district of Haryana and serves as the Sub-Divisional Office (Civil) Registering Authority. It manages vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and transport permits for the Shahabad sub-division. Given its location on the major National Highway 44, it plays a vital role in regional transport administration.
address: Sub Divisional Magistrate Office, Tehsil Building, Shahabad Markanda, District Kurukshetra, Haryana
